profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple Inc.
profile.summary:
Analytical and innovative software engineer with 15 years of experience developing scalable, high availability, enterprise web services and applications using object-oriented analysis and design, agile development practices, and SCRUM driven projects.

Specialties: Java, Groovy, Objective-C, C, Unix shells, XML, HTML, JavaScript, SQL, UML, UNIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, SunOS, Mac OSX, Hibernate, Spring, Drools, JUnit, TestNG, Maven, Ant, JDBC, JSP, Restlet, Apache httpd, Apache Tomcat, OSGi (Equinox), JBoss, Simple, Apache OfBiz, Oracle DBMS, Eclipse, Perforce, Hudson, Confluence, Hansoft, JIRA, IntelliJ, Emacs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working in Apple Services Engineering supporting the Apple Game services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to many different areas of the EA global online platform which provides distributed high availability services to support online game play and commerce. The technology used includes Apache httpd, Tomcat, JBoss, OSGi (Equinox), Java and Oracle 10g DBMS. The global online platform supports 100s thousands of simultaneous users and processes 100s thousands of transactions a minute. EA Online engineering employs agile software development practices and uses the SCRUM methodology to run projects. Responsible for screening candidates and mentoring junior engineers.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Assignments included developing an intranet site at Intel Corporation for the publication of Design Kits with fine grained access permissions. The technology used included Apache httpd, Tomcat, Java, JDO, JSP, and an Oracle DBMS.

positions.title: System Architect
positions.description: Hands on development of Java coded components for the client and application server tiers of the 3-tier enterprise Knowledge Management product CommonQuest. The Java client communicated with the servlet engine based application server using HTTP over SSL. Development involved using many different aspects of the Java platform including jdk1.3, Swing, JNI, JSSE, threads and JavaMail. As System Architect created a web application architecture for CommonQuest. Implemented the web application using the Apache Tomcat web server and JSP pages.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Assignments included: SaveSmart, Inc. Object oriented analysis and design of a custom enterprise application for the administration, web delivery, and fulfillment of coupons for brick and mortar retail merchants. Led a team to successfully deliver the merchant administration modules on a very aggressive schedule. The implementation technology included Forte Application Environment, Forte Web Enterprise, Apache Web Server, and Oracle DBMS.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Developed an object persistence layer based on NeXT's Enterprise Objects Framework EOF product and the RDBMS Sybase SQL Server. Promoted to manager of a group that successfully deployed work flow and other software components to support client customization of a Workers Compensation claims processing system. Management responsibilities extended to cover development of other application frameworks and a distributed object persistence system. Supervised staff and consultants located both on-site and off-site.
